capabilities: Run live, interactive circuit simulations from circuit code blocks in reading view and live preview
Embed .circuit files that render in notes and follow file changes
Edit .circuit files in a full editor with parts palette, scopes and analysis
Export circuits as images and CSV files into the vault
Apply themes matching Obsidian's light and dark mode
extras: Developed in the noiseweaver/Perun repository; this is a release mirror. On first opening a circuit file it downloads example circuits and translations (about 1.7 MB) from GitHub; offline the editor lacks examples and uses English menus. Works on desktop and mobile, needs no account.
intentEvidence: Perun is a rebuild of Paul Falstad's CircuitJS1: circuits from CircuitJS1 open and run the same way.
problem: Obsidian has no way to display, run or edit circuit simulations inside notes, and CircuitJS1 files are not usable in the vault.

relations.evidence: Perun is a rebuild of Paul Falstad's CircuitJS1: circuits from CircuitJS1 open and run the same way.

summary: Circuit simulation plugin that renders live, interactive circuit code blocks and opens .circuit files in a full editor based on CircuitJS1.
